incident.summary: A stale live row appeared and was later corrected by the live freshness merge and official-detail terminal reconciliation path.

invariant: Official-detail-vs-live-feed freshness must prefer the freshest verified matchup state and drop stale live rows from current live presentation.
apiVerificationProcedure: Request /api/results/live with a timestamp query to avoid cache reuse.
Confirm read-only response headers and non-stale cache behavior.
Check that the stale 1073505 row is absent from the current live payload.
Repeat the request once to confirm stability.
browserVerificationProcedure: Open the live tab in a read-only browser session.
Confirm the rendered live card uses the freshest row.
Confirm the stale Bryansk vs Izhevsk score does not reappear in the UI.
If browser tooling is unavailable, fall back to the API verification procedure and record the limitation.
cacheBustingProcedure: Use cache: no-store in live fetches.
Append a timestamp query parameter when probing the live endpoint.
Clear local fetch caches before repeating the probe.
Avoid memoized reuse of stale insight.game objects.
vercelObservabilityProcedure: Use vercel inspect in read-only mode when available.
Use vercel logs --limit 50 in read-only mode when available.
Match deployment evidence to branch, commit SHA, and deployment URL.
Treat CDN staleness and application staleness as separate failure modes.
expectedResult: No stale 1073505 row appears as the current live row.
